verdict.rationale: Bulk triage is a fair axis for a shared-inbox email client like Missive, but the evidence pack never documents selecting multiple conversations and archiving, labeling, or closing them in one action. The nearby items cover rules automation, a shared-account auto-archive list, and a label-picker sorting fix, all adjacent features rather than multi-select bulk actions.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
